tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: App window background, behind every page.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards, tables, inputs and the sidebar.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Table headers, wells, hovered rows, the track of a switch that is off.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Things that float: dialogs, menus, toasts. Always paired with a shadow.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Dimming layer behind a dialog.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairlines that only divide: table rows, card edges, section rules. Decorative, never the only boundary of a control.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Borders of controls (inputs, selects, checkboxes, secondary buttons). Holds 3:1 on bg, surface, surface-sunken and surface-raised in both themes.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and icons, on bg, surface, surface-sunken, surface-raised and every -soft tint.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, labels, table headers, metadata, on bg, surface, surface-sunken and surface-raised.

tokens.name: ink-subtle
tokens.usage: Placeholders, hints and disabled labels, on bg, surface, surface-sunken and surface-raised. The lightest text that still passes 4.5:1.

tokens.name: brand
tokens.usage: Gran (spruce). Primary buttons, the active navigation marker, checked controls, the income series in charts.

tokens.name: brand-hover
tokens.usage: Hover and pressed state of a brand fill.

tokens.name: on-brand
tokens.usage: Text and icons on brand and brand-hover. Never literal white: the dark theme needs dark text here.

tokens.name: brand-soft
tokens.usage: Tint behind brand-ink text: the selected row, the active navigation item, the Paid badge.

tokens.name: brand-ink
tokens.usage: Brand-coloured text and icons, on bg, surface, surface-sunken and brand-soft. Links use it.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Rav (amber). A fill only: highlights, the expense series in charts, the cover. Too light for text or a lone mark on light surfaces; use accent-ink there.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and icons on an accent fill.

tokens.name: accent-soft
tokens.usage: Tint behind accent-ink text: the Due soon badge, warning callouts.

tokens.name: accent-ink
tokens.usage: Amber text and icons, on bg, surface and accent-soft.

tokens.name: info
tokens.usage: Sent and other neutral-progress states; as text, on bg, surface and info-soft.

tokens.name: info-soft
tokens.usage: Tint behind info text: the Sent badge, informational toasts.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Paid, saved, done. An alias of brand-ink: money in is the brand colour. Always shown with a word or icon.

tokens.name: success-soft
tokens.usage: Tint behind success text.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Due soon, needs attention. An alias of accent-ink.

tokens.name: warning-soft
tokens.usage: Tint behind warning text.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Overdue, validation errors, destructive actions; as text on bg, surface and danger-soft, or as the fill of a destructive button. Always shown with a word or icon, never told from success by hue alone.

tokens.name: on-danger
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a danger fill.

tokens.name: danger-soft
tokens.usage: Tint behind danger text: the Overdue badge, error callouts.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus ring colour. At least 3:1 on every surface; drawn through the focus-ring shadow.

families.display: "Schibsted Grotesk Variable", "Schibsted Grotesk", "Hanken Grotesk Variable", system-ui, sans-serif
families.sans: "Hanken Grotesk Variable", "Hanken Grotesk", system-ui, -apple-system, "Segoe UI", sans-serif
families.mono: "JetBrains Mono Variable", "JetBrains Mono", ui-monospace, "SF Mono", Menlo, Consolas, monospace

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Onboarding and empty-window moments. At most once per screen.

styles.name: h3
styles.usage: Card titles and form group headings.

styles.name: body-lg
styles.sample: Alt lagres lokalt på maskinen din.
styles.usage: Onboarding copy and long-form help text.

styles.name: body
styles.usage: The default: table cells, inputs, dialog copy.

styles.name: body-strong
styles.usage: Button labels, customer names, emphasised cells.

styles.name: small
styles.usage: Hints under fields, secondary lines in a row.

styles.name: overline
styles.usage: Table column headers and stat labels. Set in uppercase.

styles.name: figure
styles.usage: The headline number of a stat card or an invoice total.

styles.name: amount
styles.usage: Every amount in a table or form. Right-aligned in columns.

styles.name: id
styles.usage: Invoice numbers, KID, organisation numbers, account numbers, dates in dense tables.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: The grid unit. Icon-to-label gap inside a badge.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between an icon and its label; between a label and its field.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Horizontal padding of inputs and table cells; gap between buttons.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Padding of cards and toasts; gap between form fields.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Padding of dialogs.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Page gutter; gap between cards on the dashboard.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Gap between page sections.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Padding of empty states.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Top of a page before its title in onboarding.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: The largest step; onboarding and marketing layouts only.

tokens.name: radius-xs
tokens.usage: Checkboxes and the selected-row marker.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Badges and small chips.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, selects, navigation items.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards, tables, dialogs, toasts.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Switches and count pills only.

tokens.name: shadow-sm
tokens.usage: Resting cards on bg, when a hairline alone is not enough.

tokens.name: shadow-md
tokens.usage: Menus, popovers and toasts on surface-raised.

tokens.name: shadow-lg
tokens.usage: Dialogs.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus on every interactive element: a 2px gap, then a solid 2px ring in focus.

tokens.name: control-sm
tokens.usage: Height of small buttons and controls inside table rows and toolbars.

tokens.name: control-md
tokens.usage: Default height of buttons, inputs and selects.

tokens.name: control-lg
tokens.usage: Height of the one primary action in onboarding and dialogs on touch screens.

tokens.name: row
tokens.usage: Height of a table row.

tokens.name: sidebar
tokens.usage: Width of the navigation sidebar.
